PASS_POINTS: V2 explicitly maps known P0 severity variants and rejects free-text P0 mentions as classification authority.
V2 binds projection to one control snapshot and fails closed on mixed-snapshot evidence.
V2 restricts terminal non-blocking statuses to exact canonical values unless an explicitly versioned extension exists.
V2 requires independent review for semantic control relevance and dedup decisions.
V2 correctly makes partial coverage incapable of proving OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: P0_CLASSIFICATION.NON_P0_RULE requires a canonical severity taxonomy artifact bound by blob SHA before any severity outside EXACT_VARIANT_MAP can become NOT_P0. SNAPSHOT_BINDING and PROJECTED_MANIFEST hash domains contain no severity_taxonomy_blob_sha or taxonomy root field. The finding universe contains ordinary P1/P2 severities, so a strict implementation must classify them UNKNOWN and force UNKNOWN_BLOCKING, while a permissive implementation can consult an unbound taxonomy. Either path prevents a deterministic valid zero proof.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Add an exact severity taxonomy artifact/schema, bind its blob/hash into SNAPSHOT_BINDING and PROJECTED_MANIFEST root object, define its normalization and lookup semantics, and independently review it. Until then, do not claim projection_status=VALID.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: STATUS_CLASSIFICATION permits a separately versioned canonical status taxonomy to add terminal non-blocking values, but no status taxonomy identity is bound into the schema/root. Two peers can therefore apply different extension taxonomies while hashing the same declared projection inputs.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Either forbid all status-taxonomy extension in V2 and use only the three exact Constitution statuses, or add a bound status_taxonomy_blob_sha/root with exact normalization and version rules.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: CLASSIFICATION_MANIFEST defines sorting and a root hash over rows but does not define a canonical exhaustive classification-record universe or a mandatory inclusion rule. A materializer can omit a higher-generation or conflicting valid record and still hash a syntactically valid manifest, defeating the highest-generation/conflict validity rules and potentially changing control relevance.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define a snapshot-bound classification-record universe, enumerate every candidate record exactly once, add completeness counts/root binding, and require projection to fail closed on any missing/duplicate/unparseable record before selecting highest generation.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: DEDUP_DECISION_MANIFEST has the same omission problem: the root hashes supplied rows but no exhaustive decision-record universe is defined. Omitting a conflicting or newer dedup decision can change canonical blocker mapping and OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define a snapshot-bound exhaustive dedup-decision universe and completeness proof before any dedup decision can affect projection.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: Validity rules only say that multiple highest-generation records that disagree become UNKNOWN. When multiple highest-generation valid records agree semantically, PROJECTED_MANIFEST still stores one singular classification_record_id and one singular dedup_decision_id, but no deterministic tie-breaker selects which ID. Semantically equivalent input can therefore produce different root bytes.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Either forbid more than one valid record at the highest generation, or define a canonical tie-break tuple and prove all tied records agree on every projection-relevant field before selecting one.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.DETAIL: classification_evidence and equivalence_basis are hash-bearing arrays of EvidenceRef objects, but V2 gives no canonical sort/dedup rule for those nested arrays. JCS preserves array order, so logically identical evidence sets can produce different classification/dedup manifest bytes.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define canonical EvidenceRef sort tuple, duplicate handling and set-vs-sequence semantics before hashing any record manifest.
